name: Otari (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Otari village emblem in white: a winged device above a ring, like a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Otari, a village in Nagano Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 1 November 1968; the emblem dates from 3 September 1968.

features.role: Otari village emblem — a winged device above a ring, like a stylised character
